welcome_title: 🎯 JobSniper ET — AI Job Matcher & Career Coach
welcome_body: Welcome, {name}! I continuously monitor 31+ Ethiopian job channels 24/7 to find high-match opportunities tailored to your profile. ✨ What I do for you: • Real-time AI Match Alerts: Instant alerts when opportunities hit your 80%+ threshold. • Instant Cover Letters: Tailored 3-paragraph drafts mapping your exact skills to the role. • AI Mock Interview Coach: 5-question STAR simulation via text or voice notes with instant feedback.

wizard_step1: 💼 Step 1 of 5: Target Job Title / Profession What is your target professional job title or primary profession? Example: Business Manager, Operations Officer, Project Manager, Fullstack Developer, Nurse, Accountant, Civil Engineer
wizard_step2: 🎓 Step 2 of 5: Education & Field of Study What is your highest degree and field of study? Example: B.Sc. in Management, B.Sc. in Computer Science, or Diploma in Nursing
wizard_step3: ⏳ Step 3 of 5: Years of Experience How many years of relevant professional experience do you have? Example: 3 years or Fresh Graduate / Entry Level
wizard_step4: 🛠️ Step 4 of 5: Core Skills & Competencies What are your strongest technical or professional skills? (Separate with commas) Example: Business Strategy, Operations Management, Financial Analysis, Leadership
wizard_step5: 📍 Step 5 of 5: Preferences & Location What work arrangement and location do you prefer? Example: Full-time in Addis Ababa, Hybrid, or Remote
wizard_completed: 🎉 Profile Created via Guided Builder! We've indexed your preferences. You are now ready to receive personalized sniper match alerts!
settings_overview: Settings Language/ቋንቋ: to change your language preference Terms and Conditions: to view our terms of service & privacy policy Profile: to view or update your career profile & qualifications
terms_and_conditions: 📄 JobSniper ET — Terms & Conditions & Privacy Policy 🔒 Data Protection & Privacy: • Your resume and profile details are encrypted using bank-grade AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption. • We do not sell, rent, or leak your private information to third-party advertisers. • You can permanently delete all your data and uploaded CV files anytime by clicking Delete Account Data or using /delete_data. 🎯 Service Operation: • JobSniper ET monitors 31+ public Ethiopian Telegram job channels 24/7 to discover vacancies matching your skills. • Match scores and skill gap tips are powered by high-speed vector embeddings and AI. ✨ Free Tier: • Core channel scanning, deduplication, instant alerts, and STAR mock interview simulations are provided 100% free of charge.
help_guide: 📖 JobSniper ET — User Guide & Commands Available Commands: • /start — Set up or view your account and choose your language. • /profile — View your structured CV profile and match settings. • /interview — Launch the 5-question STAR AI mock interview coach (Text or Voice). • /delete_data — Permanently purge all your data and CV records. • /help — Display this help manual. 🎯 How Sniper Matching Works: 1. We continuously monitor 31+ Ethiopian Telegram channels 24/7. 2. When a new job appears, our deduplication engine filters out cross-posts. 3. A 2-stage hybrid AI matcher compares the job against your skills. 4. If alignment reaches 80%+ (or your custom threshold), you receive an instant alert card with tailor-made application tools. 🔒 Privacy & Security: All uploaded resumes are encrypted with bank-grade AES-256-GCM. We never share your data with third parties.
profile_not_found: ⚠️ You have not set up a profile yet. Send /start to get started.
profile_staying_updated: Staying Updated Matters! A well maintained profile helps our AI matcher find high-salary opportunities and land your dream job sooner. View and update your career details below:
threshold_menu: 🎯 Select your Minimum Match Threshold: Only jobs matching at or above this percentage will trigger instant Telegram alerts. • 70% - 75%: Higher volume, broader opportunities. • 80% (Recommended): Balanced, high-relevance feed. • 90% - 95%: Ultra-strict exact qualification fit.
radar_resumed: Radar Resumed! You will receive live alerts.
delete_confirm_prompt: ⚠️ CONFIRM ACCOUNT & DATA PURGE This will permanently delete: • Your CV & encrypted resume files • Your structured career profile & vector embeddings • All match alerts and tailored cover letters • All mock interview transcripts This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?
